key_finding: Hsp60 antifolds cyt b2 in matrix, coupling import to inner-membrane export (conservative sorting)
confidence_limitations: High for antifolding; indirect matrix role, not translocase; sole experimental leaf for GO:0045041

confidence_limitations: High; contradicts obligatory Hsp60 role; not recorded as NOT annotation
